During Week 1, we do not have in-person sections. 
Instead please complete the following tasks by watching the associated videos. 
Please watch the videos **in the order that they are listed** on this page.
First go to Canvas course page, then click on Panopto before clicking on video links.
Feel free to come to office hours if you run into any issues or simply to say hi. 
The office hour times and locations can be found on the calendar on the [Home page](https://stat-100.com).
